data.name: Devindra
data.gender_notes: Devindra is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Devindra is a combination of two Sanskrit words – ‘Deva’ (God) and ‘Indra’ (Lord of Thunder). In Hindu mythology, Indra is the king of gods and the god of rain, storm, and lightning. This name signifies power, strength, and divine blessings. The name Devindra carries the meaning “God's Indra, Lord of Thunder” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devindra usually hope their child will grow to embody god's indra, lord of thunder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Devindra belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Indra, Lord of Thunder.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Devindra total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Devindra has deep cultural significance in Hinduism, where Indra is considered one of the most revered deities. The mere mention of the name Indra brings to mind the vivid image of a mighty and incredible god who brings life-sustaining rain to the earth. Naming a child Devindra, therefore, can instill a sense of awe and reverence for the divine, and can evoke feelings of strength and power. The name has historical importance, being mentioned in ancient Hindu texts and passed down through generations.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Devindra carries profound spiritual significance. It signifies the presence of divine blessings and divine power in one's life. The name Deva (God) itself signifies the understanding that the ultimate reality is divine, and the addition of Indra as a prefix acknowledges the manifest form of that divine reality in the form of a powerful, storm-bringing deity. Thus, Devindra is a reminder of the divine presence and power in all aspects of life, and can inspire spiritual growth and devotion in the child who bears this name. The name can serve as a daily reminder of the ultimate purpose and goal of life, which is to connect with the divine and live in accordance with its will.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Devindra: God within us, divine will. The name signifies the inner deity guiding and shaping our lives according to cosmic design.

historical_references.reference: Devindra was an ancient Hindu king of the Vatsa dynasty, who ruled from 563 to 548 BCE. He is noted for his military conquests, particularly his victory over the Magadha king Bimbisara.
Devindra is also mentioned in Hindu mythology as an incarnation of the god Indra. He is said to have appeared on the battlefield to aid the Pandavas during the Mahabharata war in the 3rd century BCE.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Devindra continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
